title: Onya Nurve wins Season 17
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S17-E16), Onya Nurve was crowned America's Next Drag Superstar after a Lip Sync for the Crown to "Abracadabra" against Jewels Sparkles. Lexi Love and Sam Star placed third after the final four cut. The Season 17 cash prize was $200,000. Crystal Envy was announced as Miss Congeniality.

title: Suzie Toot wins the Season 17 LaLaPaRuZa
summary: On Lip Sync LaLaPaRuZa Smackdown (US-S17-E15), eliminated queens returned for a lip sync tournament. Suzie Toot won the smackdown and was named the season's Golden Boot / SDADHH winner after defeating Kori King in the final round to "APT."

title: Crystal Envy is Season 17 Miss Congeniality
summary: At the Grand Finale (US-S17-E16), Crystal Envy was announced as Season 17's Miss Congeniality after being eliminated on Snatch Game (US-S17-E07).

title: Lucky Starzzz is Season 17's porkchop
summary: On Monopulence! (US-S17-E03), Lucky Starzzz lip-synced against Joella to "(It's Just) The Way That You Love Me," failed the Badonka Dunk Tank, and was the first queen eliminated, becoming Season 17's porkchop.

title: Season 17 Badonka Dunk Tank twist
summary: Season 17 introduced the Badonka Dunk Tank after Lip Sync for Your Life losses: queens pulled a lever that could dunk them into elimination or save them. Hormona Lisa was saved on Drag Queens Got Talent – Part 2 (US-S17-E02) and Arrietty was saved on RDR Live! (US-S17-E05). Lucky Starzzz (US-S17-E03) and Joella (US-S17-E04) failed their dunks and were eliminated. The twist was retired after the E05 save.

title: Jewels Sparkles and Onya Nurve double shantay
summary: On Drag Baby Mamas (US-S17-E13), Jewels Sparkles and Onya Nurve lip-synced to "1 Thing." Both were declared winners and neither was eliminated — a double shantay that kept the Top 5 intact heading into the final competitive episode.
